title: Grand Theft Auto VI hype leads to malware | Huntress

distribution.evidence: Publicly accessible publisher blog / research page at the source URL; no TLP or distribution restriction in the retained copy.

provenance.method: Independent publisher ground truth (24-report audit 2026-10-26): retained publisher HTML converted with an own stdlib parser (table cells, in-cell paragraphs, links), refang and regexes; every IOC section, publisher-declared indicator section and body observable reviewed one by one; linked GitHub inventories diffed separately. Expected = audit-verified members plus confirmed false negatives; confirmed false positives and analyst-judgment values removed.
provenance.verified_by: manual review of the publisher text (2026-10-26)
provenance.coverage_note: Formal IOC section(s) only; body observables are Context Only under MODE A.
